summary: GBIF mirrors AntWeb occurrences (919,686 records) but the fields seen carry no morphometrics or nest identifier, and the AntWeb site refused automated access (403); the one morphometric repository dataset found (Pheidole major/minor shape data, 246 species, CC0) is cross-species rather than within-nest.
